To hide the listings below (e.g. when there's nothing currently open):
  1. Change `show: true` to `show: false` in the header at the top of this file.

nav link stay up, so nobody hits a broken link. Set `show: true` again
whenever you have something to advertise.
-->

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show <- isTRUE(rmarkdown::metadata$show)
if (!show) {
  cat(
    "All of our funded positions are currently filled, but we are always",
    "happy to hear from enthusiastic and dedicated candidates! Please check",
    "back soon for new listings, see our [People](people.html) page to meet",
    "the team, or [Get Involved](contact.html) to express your interest."
  )
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```
